meme.note: Right meme for 2012 (released Jul 15; spread via Reddit Jul 28, T-Pain Jul 29, Gawker Jul 30; WP: went viral in August, No. 1 on the iTunes video chart Aug 21). Old blurb names the billion views, which only happened Dec 21, so the blurb is rewritten and the billion views is now a fact dated 12-21. Image checked: loads, 316x316 PNG.

replacement.title: Gangnam Style
replacement.blurb: Psy's horse-riding dance from Seoul spreads across the web: Oppa Gangnam Style!

facts.text: The $35 Raspberry Pi computer goes on sale (February 29).
Facebook buys Instagram for $1 billion (April 9).
London hosts the Summer Olympics (July 27 to August 12).
NASA's Curiosity rover lands on Mars (August 6).
Felix Baumgartner skydives from the stratosphere (October 14).
Gangnam Style is the first YouTube video to hit a billion views (December 21).

facts_note: Kept all 3 (correct). Curiosity landed Aug 6 05:17 UTC (still Aug 5 in California). Added Raspberry Pi, Instagram, Gangnam billion views.

tech.note: Fits: unveiled May 3, on sale May 29 (28 countries); best-selling smartphone in Q3 2012, ahead of the iPhone 4S.

meme.note: Right year (WP: became popular in late 2013; searches rising from July 2013). KYM: 4chan flooded Reddit's r/MURICA with doge images on the evening of Aug 26, 2013 (WP: 'In August 2013'). Dogecoin followed Dec 6. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 500x452 JPEG.

facts.text: Vine's six-second videos launch (January 24).
Chris Hadfield releases his 'Space Oddity' video, filmed in orbit (May 12).
Andy Murray is the first British man to win Wimbledon in 77 years (July 7).
Grand Theft Auto V earns $1 billion in three days (September 20).
Disney's Frozen opens in cinemas (November 27).
China's Chang'e 3 makes the first soft Moon landing since 1976 (December 14).

facts_note: GTA V: released Sep 17, Take-Two announced the $1 billion on Sep 20. Frozen reworded: "'Let It Go' is everywhere" was not true on Nov 27 (the song peaked in early 2014). Vine kept. Added Hadfield, Murray, Chang'e 3.

tech.note: Fits: North America Nov 15, Europe Nov 29; 1 million sold at the North American launch.

meme.note: Right year. Media attention from Jun 30 (Chris Kennedy), Matt Lauer on TV Jul 15; the surge starts Jul 29 (WP counts 2.2 million tweets and $41.8 million in donations from Jul 29). Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 500x755 JPEG.

facts.text: Flappy Bird is pulled from the app stores (February 10).
Ellen's Oscar selfie becomes the most retweeted tweet ever (March 2).
Germany wins the World Cup in Brazil (July 13).
Microsoft agrees to buy Minecraft maker Mojang for $2.5 billion (September 15).
Taylor Swift releases her album 1989 (October 27).
The Philae lander touches down on a comet (November 12).

facts_note: Flappy Bird: announced Feb 8, removed Feb 10 (date added). Germany and Philae kept. Ellen's selfie broke the retweet record within about 35 minutes on Oscar night.

tech.note: Fits 2014: WP says the term was not widely used until 2014; Time's 25 best inventions of 2014; Bloomberg: the must-have gift of the 2014 holidays. On sale in the US since 2006 (Quik Pod), so 01-01 (already available on every day of 2014).

meme.note: Right year: reposted on Tumblr and BuzzFeed's 'What Colors Are This Dress?' on Feb 26, 2015; 37 million BuzzFeed views by Mar 1. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 256x389 JPEG.

facts.text: Katy Perry's 'Left Shark' steals the Super Bowl halftime show (February 1).
The Apple Watch goes on sale (April 24).
New Horizons flies past Pluto (July 14).
Windows 10 is released (July 29).
Back to the Future Day: Marty McFly's future date arrives (October 21).
Star Wars: The Force Awakens opens (December 18).

facts_note: Kept all 3 (correct; Force Awakens premiered Dec 14, US release Dec 18). Added Left Shark, Apple Watch, Back to the Future Day.

tech.note: Fits 2015: celebrity-driven craze and the gift of Christmas 2015. Mass production began in China in 2014, so 01-01 (on sale before the year began). Fire reports and recalls came from Dec 2015 into 2016.

meme.note: Right year (WP: became popular in November 2016). First viral clip Oct 26 (Jacksonville students); KYM: by Nov 2 a full social media trend, set to 'Black Beatles'. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 500x281 JPEG.

facts.text: Scientists announce the first detection of gravitational waves (February 11).
Leicester City win the Premier League as 5000-1 outsiders (May 2).
Pokemon Go launches and players head outside to catch them all (July 6).
Rio de Janeiro hosts the first Olympics in South America (August 5 to 21).
Bob Dylan wins the Nobel Prize in Literature (October 13).
The Chicago Cubs win their first World Series since 1908 (November 3).

facts_note: 'Pokemon' was non-ASCII (e acute), fixed; reworded so it is true on launch day (Jul 6 in AU, NZ, US). Leicester (May 2) and gravitational waves (Feb 11) dated. Cubs: Game 7 began Nov 2 but ended after midnight on Nov 3, hence 11-03.

tech.note: Fits: released Nov 10 (Japan, Australia), Nov 11 (US, Europe); sold out within hours.

meme.note: Right year. WP: 'The meme started going viral on August 19, 2017' (first used in a Facebook group in January). Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 387x258 JPEG.

facts.text: La La Land is wrongly named Best Picture; Moonlight is the winner (February 26).
Fidget spinners become the toy craze of the spring (May 4).
'Despacito' becomes YouTube's most-viewed video (August 4).
A total solar eclipse crosses the United States (August 21).
Fortnite Battle Royale comes out, free to play (September 26).
The iPhone X goes on sale with Face ID and no home button (November 3).

facts_note: Fidget spinners: WP has no day, so dated by NPR 'Fidget Spinner Emerges As Must-Have Toy Of The Year' (May 4; source is the WUSF copy because npr.org timed out). Despacito: most-viewed from Aug 4. Eclipse kept.

meme.note: Right year. WP: the original GIF originated May 7, 2018 and the reply set to music went viral. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 248x251 PNG.

facts.text: SpaceX's Falcon Heavy launches a Tesla car into space (February 6).
Fortnite mania: Drake and Ninja set a Twitch viewing record (March 15).
Avengers: Infinity War breaks the opening weekend record (April 29).
France beats Croatia 4-2 to win the World Cup (July 15).
Apple becomes the first US public company worth $1 trillion (August 2).
NASA's InSight lander touches down on Mars (November 26).

facts_note: Fortnite craze anchored to the Drake/Ninja stream (began the evening of Mar 14 US time, ran overnight, reported Mar 15; WP gives only 'March 2018'). Infinity War opened Apr 27; the record weekend was reported Apr 29. Falcon Heavy kept. Apple date from History of Apple Inc. (Apple Inc. lead: first US public company over $1 trillion in 2018).

tech.note: Fits: WP says the Echo Dot was among Amazon's top-selling products in 2017 and 2018. 2nd gen on sale since Oct 20, 2016, so 01-01; 3rd gen introduced Sep 2018.

meme.note: Right year. First combined by @MISSINGEGIRL on May 1, 2019; WP: a Reddit post on June 2 'surged the meme into massive notoriety'. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 447x223 JPEG.

facts.text: China's Chang'e 4 makes the first landing on the Moon's far side (January 3).
Astronomers reveal the first image of a black hole (April 10).
Game of Thrones airs its final episode (May 19).
Avengers: Endgame becomes the top-grossing film of all time (July 21).
Eliud Kipchoge runs a marathon distance in under two hours (October 12).
Disney+ launches (November 12).

facts_note: Endgame: passed Avatar with the Jul 20-21 weekend grosses (Disney said Saturday night it was set to pass; AP story Jul 21), so 07-21. Black hole and Disney+ kept. Kipchoge: 'marathon distance' because the Vienna run was not an official record.

meme.note: Right year. WP: became a meme in March 2020; TikTok versions Mar 6 and Mar 14 (KYM), a YouTube video 'elevating the trend' Mar 30, on Twitter and Instagram by late March. Blurb fine. Note: WP ties its popularity to the COVID-19 pandemic. Image checked: loads, 400x225 JPEG.

facts.text: Parasite is the first non-English film to win Best Picture (February 9).
Animal Crossing: New Horizons is everyone's island escape (March 20).
SpaceX launches its first astronauts to the space station (May 30).
BTS's 'Dynamite' is the first US No. 1 by an all-Korean act (August 31).
Among Us mania: 3.8 million people play at the same time (September 29).
Jupiter and Saturn meet in the sky, the closest since 1623 (December 21).

facts_note: BTS: The Fader (Aug 31) dates the No. 1 debut; 'first all-South Korean act to top the Hot 100' is from WP Dynamite_(BTS_song). SpaceX reworded to 'launches' (launched May 30, docked May 31). Among Us dated: 3.8 million concurrent players over the last September weekend, reported Sep 29 (WP: 'late September'). Animal Crossing kept (5 million digital copies in March).

tech.note: Fits: Nov 12 (US, Japan, Australia, NZ, South Korea), Nov 19 elsewhere; scarce for months (chip shortage).

meme.note: Right year. Ever Given ran aground Mar 23, 2021 (07:40 local); KYM: the cropped excavator photo went viral the same day (1,400 retweets in a day), with more memes Mar 24-26. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 500x333 JPEG.

facts.text: Olivia Rodrigo releases her debut single 'drivers license' (January 8).
NASA's Ingenuity makes the first powered flight on Mars (April 19).
Friends: The Reunion brings the cast back together (May 27).
Tokyo hosts the delayed Summer Olympics (July 23 to August 8).
Squid Game becomes Netflix's biggest series launch ever (October 13).
The James Webb Space Telescope launches (December 25).

facts_note: Squid Game: premiered Sep 17; Netflix announced 111 million accounts and its 'biggest series launch ever' on Oct 12 (US), Oct 13 in Asia and Europe, so 10-13. 'Most-watched series ever' only came with the Nov 16 hours metric. Ingenuity and JWST kept.

tech.note: Fits 2021: 10 million shipped by Nov 2021; the Oculus app was the top US app at Christmas 2021. Released Oct 13, 2020, so 01-01 (available all of 2021).

meme.note: Right year. WP: widespread popularity in late 2021 after the emoji share grid; 90 players on Nov 1, 2021, over 300,000 by Jan 2, 2022; NYT bought it Jan 31. Viral before the year began, so 01-01. Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 223x232 PNG.

facts.text: Elden Ring, FromSoftware's open-world epic, is released (February 25).
Top Gun: Maverick flies into cinemas, 36 years after the original (May 27).
The James Webb telescope's first full-color images are shown (July 12).
NASA's DART probe crashes into an asteroid on purpose (September 26).
ChatGPT is released to the public (November 30).
Argentina and Messi win the World Cup in Qatar (December 18).

facts_note: Kept all 3 (correct; the single preview image was Jul 11, the full-color set Jul 12). DART hit at 23:14 UTC Sep 26.

tech.note: Fits: released Feb 25, 2022 (North America, Europe); first-day reservations crashed Steam's servers.

meme.note: Right year. Viral from late June: KYM logs a Jun 29 'I survived Barbenheimer' tweet, GamesRadar 'The internet is exploding with Barbie and Oppenheimer memes' (Jun 30, cited in WP). Old blurb describes opening day (Jul 21: fans in pink at double bills), so it is rewritten to be true from 06-30. If you prefer the old blurb, use on 07-21. Image checked: loads, 500x375 JPEG.

replacement.title: Barbenheimer
replacement.blurb: Barbie and Oppenheimer open the same day; fans plan a pink-and-black double bill.

facts.text: Everything Everywhere All at Once wins Best Picture (March 12).
Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom is released (May 12).
Lionel Messi signs for Inter Miami in the US (July 15).
India's Chandrayaan-3 lands near the Moon's south pole (August 23).
OSIRIS-REx drops a sample of asteroid Bennu in the Utah desert (September 24).
Taylor Swift's Eras Tour is the first tour to gross $1 billion (December 8).

facts_note: Eras Tour dated: Pollstar's report of Dec 8, 2023 (WP: 'in December 2023'). Zelda and Chandrayaan-3 kept.

tech.note: Acceptable: released Oct 10, 2023; the Meta Quest app was the No. 1 free iPhone app on Christmas Day 2023 (UploadVR), but Quest 2 outsold Quest 3 that holiday. Consider the label 'Meta Quest VR headset'.

meme.note: Right year. Born Jul 10; WP: photos went viral in September 2024, zoo visitors doubled in early September. Earliest page I could load: 'is going viral' on Sep 13 (Khaosod English called her the viral pygmy hippo on Sep 12 but blocks fetches). Blurb fine. Image checked: loads, 500x375 JPEG.

facts.text: Dune: Part Two opens in cinemas (March 1).
A total solar eclipse crosses North America (April 8).
A solar storm brings northern lights as far south as Florida (May 10).
Paris hosts the Summer Olympics (July 26 to August 11).
SpaceX catches a Starship booster with giant 'chopsticks' (October 13).
Wicked opens in US cinemas (November 22).

facts_note: Kept all 3 (correct). Northern lights: storm arrived May 10, auroras that night as far south as the Florida Keys and Spain.

tech.note: Acceptable: US release Feb 2, 2024; launch stock sold out in 18 minutes, up to 200,000 pre-orders. The year's most talked-about gadget, not a mass-market hit.

meme.note: Right year (WP: emerged in early 2025). First viral Tralalero Tralala clip Jan 13 (17 million plays); KYM: by Mar 14 TikTok users ranked 'all the brainrot Italian animal memes', so the whole cast the blurb names was viral by then. Image checked: loads, 500x500 PNG.

facts.text: Kendrick Lamar headlines the Super Bowl halftime show (February 9).
A Minecraft Movie opens; 'Chicken jockey!' becomes a cinema chant (April 4).
Labubu mania: a human-sized Labubu sells for $150,000 at auction (June 10).
Oasis play their first concert since 2009, in Cardiff (July 4).
KPop Demon Hunters becomes Netflix's most-watched film ever (August 26).
Taylor Swift releases The Life of a Showgirl (October 3).

facts_note: All 3 existing facts were undated: Minecraft Movie Apr 4 (chant from opening weekend), KPop Demon Hunters Aug 26 (236 million views, past Red Notice), Labubu reworded around the dated record auction (1.08 million yuan, Beijing, Jun 10; WP: June 2025).

tech.note: Fits: global release June 5, 2025; 3.5 million sold in four days, Nintendo's fastest-selling console.
